chapter: Musicians of the era: players, drummers, bassists, pianists
title: Chick Webb's trumpet and reed sections
summary: Jackson lists Webb's best band with Vance, Stark and Jordan and a sax section of Jefferson, Carver, Elmer Williams and Pete Clark.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: A very good band he had. He had a beautiful band when he had Dick Vance and Bobby Stark and he had Taft Jordan.
That's the three trumpets you mentioned?
Uh-huh, and who was in the reed section?
Hilton Jefferson was in there for a
while and -- The saxophone player from --
-- Clark, Pete Clark. Waymond Carver was in there. Elmer Williams. That was the four saxophones he had.
Let's see. Hilton Jefferson alto, Waymond Carver played flute and what?
Elmer Williams was the tenor player.
And -- oh, what was the fourth baritone player's name? Yeah, well, Pete Clark used to double on baritone, too.
